units.source_text: 传右卫门看到他一言不发，揣测他可能是因为态度十分谦虚，对他的钦佩之情更多了。

en.t: Seeing that he said nothing at all, Den'emon guessed that it might be because he was extremely modest in manner, and his admiration for him grew even stronger.

units.source_text: 为了表达自己对内藏助的钦佩之心，老实本分的肥后武士硬把话题一转，马上开始了对忠义的内藏助的赞扬：

en.t: To express his admiration for Kuranosuke, the honest and dutiful Higo samurai forced the conversation in a new direction and immediately began praising loyal Kuranosuke:

units.source_text: “以前曾经听一位很有学问的人讲过，

en.t: "I once heard a very learned man say,

units.source_text: 中国有一位武士，为了给自己的主人复仇，不惜吞炭变成了哑巴。

en.t: In China there was a warrior who, in order to avenge his own lord, went so far as to swallow charcoal and become mute.

units.source_text: 但是他的痛苦跟内藏助大人的比起来，真是小巫见大巫，

en.t: But compared with Lord Kuranosuke's suffering, his pain was truly nothing beside it,

units.source_text: 因为达人还要违背自己的意愿假装出放浪形骸的模样。”

en.t: because that great man must even go against his own wishes and pretend to be a dissolute wastrel."
